title: FR-1's first acceptance: a closed compartment (cell_owned_compartments@1) loaded and released by exchange@1's laws, exchange's first judged acceptance, against independent references, with silence, energy, restart, batch, refusals and planted controls
status: PROPOSED (drafted 17 November 2026 by the FR owner on branch fr1-protocol, from docs/CLOSED_COMPARTMENT_DESIGN.md §6.3's items C1 to C13, against the declaration as built in milestone 1, §12). Not registered; registration is the lead's

registration_plan.no_judged_run_yet: No run of this protocol exists. Milestone 1 ran its gates and S1 to S5 as development checks (development_runs)

the world builders of every part (validation/tissue/compartment_acceptance_fixtures.py; C9 and C2 use compartment_fixtures' W and W+)

registration_plan.path: the references and the tools; the dt study (development); a rehearsal of every judged part on a registered dry-run copy; the lead's registration; one judged run from a clean snapshot of main (the D150/MG0c path, as FR-4's, FR-5's and FR-10's)
registration_plan.move_2: registration and the judged run sit on the same side of D188's move 2 (the lead's rule of 17 November 2026)

rung: FR-1, acceptance 1 (numerical verification, D174's first claim kind; no biological comparison, D151)
question: Does cell_owned_compartments@1 hold a closed compartment as a declared node whose content exchange@1's laws load and release exactly (the flux and first-order exports and the saturable import at rounding against their closed forms), whose two-way first-order exchange converges at second order to its closed form and equals the palindrome's step map at rounding, whose compositions with turnover's clearance, D152's reaction and an uptake path follow their linear systems, which stays electrically silent beside a live owner, whose every law books its moved amounts' exact free-energy change (from a trace too), whose runs restart and batch bitwise, whose every refusal holds with its reason, whose declaration is pure identity, and whose planted misbookings are caught?
engine_models: resolved_pump_composite@1 over resolved_pump_tissue@3 (the composite and its inner model)
cell_owned_compartments@1 (the declaration: identity, the topology refusals, the admitted list)
scheduled_species_exchange@1 with its step palindromic_exact_exchange_stages@1 (the laws judged: flux and first-order export, first-order and saturable import)
scheduled_species_turnover@1 (C6's first-order clearance at the node)
local_species_reactions@1 (C7's first-order S -> P at the node)
constant_field@1 (W+'s K leak on the owner's wall, C9)
the IDs the judged definitions print are checked against this list by the generator (pre-registration)
scope: The neutral first version (§3.3): no ion route and a zero charge anchor on the compartment, no face naming its node, a held-bath topology, one compartment per node, compositions on §4's admitted list. One neutral species S (C7 adds P). Every world synthetic and species-only (D150's quiescent worlds) except C9's W+, whose owner is live. Not claimed: version 1.1's charged routes and anchors (FR-4 and FR-5 judged those), the doors (T1, T2, V, R, D, C, F), any biological comparison, vesicles, stochastic loading, volume change (§6.4)

worlds.builders: validation/tissue/compartment_acceptance_fixtures.py (every part but C2's and C9's, which use validation/tissue/compartment_fixtures.py's W and W+). Every world: the owner cell_0 (1 pL) with its wall on the held bath, the compartment lys_0 at node ecs_0 (0.1 pL) behind its bounding patch contact_0 (1e-11 m^2), no face naming ecs_0, S neutral, records every 10 ms on the step grid unless stated
worlds.C3_loading: flux_loading (J = 1e-4 fmol/s) and first_order_loading (k_e = 0.5/s): the cytosol's 1e-3 mM pool into the compartment at 1e-6 mM, 5 s, ARS at the declared 1 ms. Each law is one exact stage per half-step
worlds.C4_two_way: two_way: a first-order export (a = 10/s) and a first-order import (b = kappa = 20/s, k_u = 2e-4 m/s) on the bounding patch, from the pool, 1 s (thirty relaxation times), ARS on the ladder 1, 0.5, 0.25 and 0.125 ms
worlds.C5_saturable: saturable_release: the compartment at 1e-2 mM (1e-3 fmol) released into the cytosol by a saturable import, a = A V_max = 2e-4 fmol/s, K_M = 5e-3 mM (b = 5e-4 fmol), 5 s, ARS at 1 ms
worlds.C6_degradation: load_and_degrade: first-order loading (k_e = 1/s) with turnover's first-order clearance at ecs_0 (k = 2/s), 3 s, ARS on the ladder
worlds.C7_reaction: load_and_react: first-order loading (k_e = 1/s) with D152's mass-action S -> P at ecs_0 (k_r = 2/s; S and P one moiety; P at the trace elsewhere), 3 s, ARS on the ladder
worlds.C8_uptake: uptake_path: ecs_e (2 pL, face-free, S at 1e-3 mM; unequal to the cytosol's 1 pL so that a kappa on the wrong volume shows, the references' power finding) -> the cytosol by a first-order import on contact_e (kappa_u = 2/s) -> the compartment by a first-order export (k_e = 1/s), a closed three-node chain, 5 s, ARS on the ladder
worlds.C9_silence: W+ (compartment_fixtures.live_compartment: the owner at K 140, Na 10, Cl 20 mM with a K leak and -0.06 V through its anchor; the compartment loaded by exchange), in the scalar, windowed, vector-window and batch programs, under RK4 at 0.1 ms, and across a restart through a snapshot; S4 against live_without_compartment
worlds.C10_energy: every C3, C4 and C5 world's route work against its free-energy change; C6's loading with clearance, whose S leaves the two nodes (sum dn != 0, so a dropped -1 or another standard state in G shows), against R-energy; the RK4 face-free world (C3's first-order loading at 0.1 ms, every row); the IMEX species-only worlds of C3 to C8. The exact SI constants throughout, as FR-10's: with Appendix A's rounded RT, dG moves by 2.5e-8 to 1.2e-6 pJ, a margin of only 1 to 60 against RK4's 2e-8 pJ (the references' finding)
worlds.C11_from_trace: from_trace: each of the four laws (flux and first-order export into a 1e-15 mM compartment; saturable and first-order import into a 1e-15 mM cytosol) under ARS at 1 ms (1 s) and RK4 at 0.1 ms (0.2 s), recorded at every step
worlds.C12_restart_batch: two_way with a change of both rates at 0.5 s: restarts through the engine's checkpoint at 0.25, 0.5 and 0.75 s (before, at and after the change), in process and through a snapshot; a vector batch of four worlds with different compartment volumes and rates against each world's scalar run and against the reversed batch
worlds.C13_controls: each plant in its own process (validation/tissue/compartment_acceptance_plants), its identity and size in its bundle (the lead's ruling 2). A misbooked move: C3's first-order loading under ARS at 1 ms, recorded at every step to 0.1 s, where the compartment's S is raised by 1e-6 of the route's booked move, its accumulator unchanged. A misbooked work: C10's RK4 world to 0.3 s, where the route's booked work is scaled by 1 + 2e-3. The rows before a plant are the unplanted run's; the planted row is the edited checkpoint, which the engine checks on resuming (runner.validate_checkpoint runs the row checks): a state edit, so no engine code is patched and no compiled step is shared with a judged world
worlds.C1_refusals: a representative of each of §1.4's refusals 1 to 7 beside its admitted neighbour (FR-10's ruling 4), with the reason each must name: R1 a face naming the node, R1 a held bath declared as the node, R2 a second patch facing the node, R3 two compartments on one node, R4 a K permeability on the bounding patch, R5 a 1e-17 C anchor, R6 an owner whose capacitor component holds no held bath (a gauge instead), R7 replacement@1 scheduling an event on the owner; each neighbour is W (or replacement on the other cell)
worlds.C2_identity: S5's four traced pairs (W under ARS and RK4, W with clearance beside exchange, the declaration alone against no operators): program text, constants and bindings identical

references.R_step_map: A.4: the palindrome's step map at each rung, iterated, its fixed point x* and the splitting term beside -a(a + 2b) dt^2/96, with a floor

budgets.status: declared before any protocol run (FR-10's rule, the lead's ruling of 17 November 2026: declared first; the dt study reports against them as development)
budgets.B_split: C4's closed form, C6, C7 and C8 (the items with a splitting error): each node's S (and C7's P) within 1e-3 of the world's initial S (and P) content, a declared number (about 1e-6 fmol in each of these worlds), of the reference at every record at the declared 1 ms, and each observable's Richardson error within it. The scale is the world's initial content because it is positive in every world, while a node's largest change can be zero (the lead's ruling 1)
budgets.rounding: C3, C5, C11's trajectories and C4's step map: within the classes rule's floor, N eps max|q| over the run's N steps (FR-4's), times 10; C5 also within its Newton tolerance, NEWTON_RTOL = 1e-12 of the solve's absolute terms per step
budgets.energy: each world's summed route work (and C6's clearance work) within 10 x 2N eps times the largest size of G's terms over the run, RT sum |n (ln(n/V) - 1)|, of the free-energy change of its nodes along the engine's own trajectory (each booked change is a difference of such terms, two half-steps per step); R-energy's trajectory reported beside it
budgets.silence: S1 to S3 as §3.3 fixed them before milestone 1, unchanged
budgets.controls_margin: each control differs from its arm by at least 10 x the arm's budget or bound on the same quantity

criteria.C1_refusals: each refusal class's representative refused by its own check with its reason, and its neighbour admitted and run
criteria.C2_identity: S5: the four traced pairs identical in program text, constants and bindings
criteria.C3_loading: both laws' node amounts at rounding of R-closed at every record; each route's moved accumulator equal to the node's gain at rounding (per-route reconciliation)
criteria.C4_two_way: the observed order of each node's S on the three finest rungs by FR-4's classes rule; at the declared 1 ms, the Richardson error and the difference from R-closed within B_split; at every rung, the engine equal to R-step-map's iterated map at rounding; the engine's late-time x within rounding of A.4's x*; and the splitting term identified: at every rung the engine's x/x_eq - 1 at the last record within 1e-3 relative of -a(a + 2b) dt^2/96, the fixed point's relative displacement as docs/CLOSED_COMPARTMENT_DESIGN.md §2.3 derives it and §6.3 names it (main 4adb6fed; the lead's ruling 6); its next term is O(dt^4): 5.3e-6 relative at 1 ms
criteria.C5_saturable: the node amounts within rounding and the Newton tolerance of R-closed's implicit solution at every record
criteria.C6_C7_C8_linear: each node's S (C7's P too) at the declared 1 ms within B_split of R-linear at every record; orders on the ladder by the classes rule; C6's cleared amount and C7's moiety within B_split
criteria.C9_silence: S1 bitwise, S2 and S3 within @3's charge tolerance at every row in every program and across the restart; the owner live (its K row moving, |phi| >= 0.05 V); S4 reported
criteria.C10_energy: each world's summed route work (and C6's clearance work) equal to its nodes' free-energy change at rounding on the engine's own trajectory; C6's summed work against R-energy's change of both nodes' G within RT B_split sum_i max_t |ln c_i| (B_split carried through dG/dn_i = RT ln c_i); the RK4 world within the absolute 2e-8 pJ at every row; the IMEX worlds' energy residual over the integrated flows <= 2e-3 at every record
criteria.C11_from_trace: every row of the eight runs: the energy ledger within its bound (RK4's absolute 2e-8 pJ; ARS's 2e-3 relative), and the onset step's residual at rounding of its own flows; the trajectory at rounding of R-energy's
criteria.C12_restart_batch: every restart bitwise the straight run from its time; each batched world within 1e-12 relative of its scalar run and bitwise its place in the reversed batch
criteria.C13_controls: the misbooked move fails the compartment's outside ledger while the cytosol's passes; the misbooked work fails the RK4 world's energy ledger. Exactly the planted rows are flagged: every unplanted row before a plant within every bound, and the planted row refused by the engine naming the plant's ledger; each detection margin, the planted row's ratio to its bound, at least 10 x (the move's about 9e6 x, the work's about 21 x; stated in the bundle)

controls.K1: C4 at the declared rung against R-closed without its import (a one-way world's solution): at least 10 x B_split
controls.K2: C6 without its clearance against R-linear's C6: at least 10 x B_split
controls.split_order: the controls' margins over B_split in C6 to C8 hold because the split is second order: at 1 ms a first-order (Lie) split would err by about 2.5e-7 fmol, close to a tenth of a 1% rate error's 2e-6 fmol, where the Strang split errs by about 6e-11 (the references' power finding). The dt study's observed order separates the two: a split error falls with dt, a rate error does not
controls.swapped_palindrome: a swapped palindrome (the stages in another order) is invisible against C4's closed form; only the comparison with R-step-map's iterated map catches it, with a margin of 4.6e3 at 0.125 ms (the references' power finding): C4_step_map is the check that catches it
controls.K3: C9's planted controls (a) a K route of 1e-13 m/s and (b) a 1e-17 C anchor on the compartment, through milestone 1's test-only bypass of refusals 4 and 5, each in its own process (the lead's ruling 2): the anchor breaks S2 at every row, the route breaks S1 and S2 at every row after its first, each S2 ratio at least 10 x its bound, and no other row flagged
controls.K4: C12: a restart with the rate change moved one step is not bitwise the straight run
controls.K5: C13's two plants (the criteria's own controls)

checks: the Richardson error at the declared 1 ms within B_split
the energy residual over flows <= 2e-3 at the declared 1 ms, falling at second order down the ladder
dt_study_criteria_written_first.verdict: the declared 1 ms stands if every check holds; otherwise the arm declares the finest rung that passes, reported, not repaired

harness_limits: a part ended by its runtime limit or memory cap is a harness failure, not a verdict: the judged run is void and is relaunched once, whole, from the same snapshot; a second harness failure goes to the lead. An engine refusal is a verdict
recording_rules: the generator writes records only (results.json per unit); the judge reads records and never runs; parts from more than one source are refused
every record carries the snapshot's identity; a judged run comes from a clean snapshot
undefined values are None, never NaN; a None fails its criterion
reported_not_judged: S4 (the rest of the world against the world without the node)
compile time, memory and cost per step
the splitting term's ratio to its leading form at each rung
C12: whether each batched world is also bitwise its scalar run (observed so in development; the criterion stays 1e-12 relative, the lead's ruling 4)
what_it_does_not_show: no biological comparison (a measured trafficking or uptake dataset, registered on its own, D151); no charged content (FR-4 and FR-5); no vesicles, stochastic loading or volume change; integration grants no acceptance (D143). V_b's orientation: C9 claims silence (V_b = 0), and a sign error in V_b cannot show in a silent compartment (the references' power finding; the lead's ruling: not shown). The references' other zero-power cases are given power before registration: a kappa on the wrong volume by C8's unequal volumes (2 pL against 1 pL), a dropped -1 or another standard state in G by C6's energy check (sum dn != 0)
outcome_rules: a criterion passes or fails as written; a failed criterion is reported, not repaired; the protocol passes when every judged criterion passes

runs.status: milestone 1's gates (§12): the tier-1 smoke, S5's four pairs, S1 to S3 in W+ with the planted controls in every program family, crossrev

development_runs.note: development evidence only: no run of this protocol exists

questions_answered: 1. Budgets (the lead, 17 November 2026): confirmed. B_split is 1e-3 of each world's initial total content, a scale positive in every world, where a node's largest change can be zero; rounding items at 10 x the classes rule's floor

2. C13's plants (the lead): a test-only plant in the generator's control part, with four conditions: each planted part runs in its own subprocess, so no plant reaches a judged world; each plant's identity and size are recorded in its bundle; the judge flags exactly the planted rows and nothing else; each detection margin over its bound is stated and at least 10 x. The move at 1e-6 relative; the work at 1e-4 relative, about 13 x RK4's absolute 2e-8 pJ, its margin stated. K3 by milestone 1's bypass of refusals 4 and 5. As built, C13's plants edit the checkpoint state at the planted row in their own process (no engine code patched), so the engine's own row checks see exactly that row. The work's plant is 2e-3, not 1e-4: 1e-4 was accepted on the FR owner's estimate of the booked work at the planted row (about 2.6e-3 pJ); the first development run measured 2.1e-4 pJ there, a margin of 1.06; 2e-3 gives about 21, and condition (d), at least 10, decides
3. C2's and C9's scope (about 6 CPU minutes): confirmed
4. C12 as §6.3 wrote it: within 1e-12 of the scalar run and bitwise against the reversed batch; the bitwise equality to the scalar runs observed in development is reported, not judged
5. The synthetic values: confirmed, as the registered inputs state them
6. The splitting term is relative, x*/x_eq - 1, as §2.3 derives it; the design note says so at all three mentions (main 4adb6fed); C4 judges it so and cites the note
disclosures: Drafted on 17 November 2026 after milestone 1, whose gates and silence results are known (§12). No budget, threshold or ladder here has been run against: no generator exists, and the worlds were only admitted and run once to their horizons to check they are well posed
The reference input file was written before this draft, at the lead's request, from the same builders, and is pinned to them

17 November 2026 (FR owner), before any run of the protocol: quick development runs of every part but the stand-ins (0.4 of each horizon) tested the tools. One tool change followed: C10's closure was first bounded by N eps times the engine's recorded energy magnitudes, which the from-trace RK4 worlds exceeded at rounding (ratios 1.3 and 1.6: their changes are differences of G's much larger terms); it is now bounded by 10 x 2N eps times the largest size of G's terms, a rounding scale from A.10's form, not from the runs (the largest ratio is then 7.6e-4; in C3's flux world, by estimate, a misbooked work above about 1e-10 relative still fails). No other criterion or threshold changed. B_split became 1e-3 of the world's initial content (declared) instead of 1e-3 of each node's largest change (which needed the reference)

17 November 2026 (FR owner), before any run of the protocol: C13's work plant is 2e-3 of the booked work, not the 1e-4 the lead first accepted. 1e-4 rested on the FR owner's estimate of the booked work at the planted row (about 2.6e-3 pJ); the first development run measured 2.1e-4 pJ there, a margin of only 1.06 over RK4's absolute 2e-8 pJ; 2e-3 gives 21, above the ruling's 10 (the lead accepted it, 17 November)

17 November 2026 (FR owner), after the references registered and before any engine output of the protocol, at the lead's ruling on their power findings: C8's extracellular node is 2 pL (it was 1 pL, equal to the cytosol, so a kappa on the wrong volume could not show); C6 joins R-energy (sum dn != 0, so a dropped -1 or another standard state shows); the inputs file was regenerated, and the references register a dated amendment before any engine output
